body.decided: The author, 2026-11-06, approving the session's reading of the licence; read anew by the author, 2026-11-07: the paper's holons and the readings built upon them may be public. A reading, not legal advice.
says: BY: whenever it is shared, the authors are credited, the licence linked, and any change said.
NC: it is never shared for commercial advantage.
ND: what is adapted from it, its text rearranged, abridged, translated or edited, is never shared. Sharing is all the licence governs.

A change of format is no adaptation: the licence says so itself (section 2(a)(4)), and the paper as holons is its own text, in its own order and word, only carried otherwise, reading back word for word. It may be public.

Holons built upon it are no adaptation either: the readings say in their own words what they find, quote it only briefly, and hold its paragraphs by reference, never rearranging or abridging its presentation. That is the hygiene of building upon a work rather than reworking it. They may be public.
The boundary for NC: the author's CV and everything toward the author's own branding stand in a holarchy of their own, decoupled from this paper and what is drawn on it.

body.says: A union of stores: every run and saved store read as one field. It points at their roots and holds none of them, moves none and rewrites none, so it is always divisible again into the stores it reads.
